newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Pakistan oilseed, veg oil output to rise slowly.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan oilseed, veg oil output to rise slowly.

text.p: Pakistan's oilseed and vegetable oil production should post steady gains over the next few years, a member of the Pakistan Vanaspati Manufacturers Association said on Friday.

Syed Yawar Ali said, at an edible oil markets conference in Singapore, oilseed production in the 1996/97 season could rise to 4.07 million tonnes against 4.03 million tonnes in 1995/96. He said output could then increase to 5.40 million tonnes in 1999/2000.
Domestic vegetable oil output should also go up to an estimated 671,000 tonnes in 1996/97 from last season's 526,334 tonnes. Production is then projected to rise to 879,445 tonnes by 1999/2000.
Most of the increase will come from canola plantings, with production shooting up from zero in 1993/94 to an estimated 300,000 tonnes in 1996/97, he said.
